title: Pixel Q (Your Personal AI Agent)
description:
## Pixel Q — A Truly Secure Local AI Butler

🤖 **One-time Purchase · Perpetual Use · Zero Subscription Fee**

🔒 **100% Local Operation · Data Never Leaves Your Computer**

---

### 🔐 Permission Confirmation: AI Can Be Powerful, But It Cannot Overstep its Limits

Some AI tools on the market can directly control your computer without any braking mechanism—it's like a car without brakes; would you dare get in?

Pixel Q has a robust permission confirmation system built in from the ground up. Every high-risk operation requires your explicit consent:

🖱️ Controlling the mouse or keyboard → A pop-up request for authorization will appear first.

🔌 Shutting down/sleeping/restarting → Voice or pop-up confirmation required.

🌐 Accessing websites not on the whitelist → A security warning will pop up, and you will have to decide.

🛡️ Terminating suspicious processes → Real-time alerts will be sent, and you will have to choose whether to handle them.

💻 Modifying program code → Secondary confirmation and automatic backup of the original file.

**You are not giving AI a blank check, but a authorization form that requires your signature to be effective.** **

---

### 🧠 Five Local Models Working Together

All models run on your own computer, no internet connection required:

💬 Everyday Conversation Model → Multilingual Communication

🧩 Deep Reasoning Model → Logic Analysis, Code Generation

⚡ Lightweight Task Model → Quick and Simple Response

👁️ Visual Model → Image Understanding and Description

🔧 General Execution Model → Background Task Processing

---

### 🗣️ Communicate Like a Real Person

🎤 Voice Wake-up → Say the wake-up word, and Pixel Q responds immediately

🧠 Multi-turn Memory → Remember context, ensuring seamless conversation

😊 Emotional Awareness → It can tell if you're happy or annoyed, automatically adjusting its tone.

🗣️ Conversational replies → Automatically converts written text into natural spoken language.

🌐 18 interface languages ​​+ multiple voice synthesis languages ​​→ Interface and voice can be configured separately.

---

### 🖥️ Your computer, it controls it for you.

📂 Voice-activated programs → Say "Open Excel" to execute instantly.

🎥 Macro recording and playback → Record mouse and keyboard actions, one-click automatic replay.

🌐 Browser control → Switch tabs, close tabs, search websites.

🔊 Volume, window, system status → All can be controlled by voice or text.

---

### 📄 Understand your documents, comprehend your images

📎 Drag and drop files for analysis → PDF, Word, Excel, PPT

🖼️ Image OCR and Visual Description → Recognize text within images and describe image content

👁️ Local Visual Model → No cloud upload required

---

### 📅 Daily Proactive Reports on Itineraries and Emails

📆 Itinerary Calendar → Add, edit, and query at a glance

📬 Gmail Check → Automatically retrieves unread emails and provides daily summary reports

☀️ Proactive Greetings → Daily push notifications of weather, holidays, itineraries, and email summaries

---

### 🌐 Safe Internet Access, Intelligent Search

🛡️ Whitelist Mechanism → Only allow access to websites you trust

🔍 Deep Search → Combines DuckDuckGo and Wikipedia, AI automatically summarizes

📚 Permanent Knowledge Base → Automatically extracts and saves important conversations, getting smarter the more you use it

---

### 🎨 It can act out any personality you want

🎭 Customize Personality → Set the AI's personality, tone, and catchphrases

📤 Share and Import → Export your customized personality files or load others' creations

🌍 Independent Multilingual Settings → The interface language and the AI's speaking language are completely separate

---

### 📚 Learning Mode

🎯 Tell Pixel Q a learning goal

🌐 It will automatically search the internet for information and organize knowledge

💡 It even offers suggestions for new feature improvements.

---

**Pixel Q isn't just a chatty toy; it's a disciplined, obedient, and capable personal AI assistant.**

**It works for you, it doesn't make decisions for you.**
description_short: Pixel Q is a fully local, one‑time purchase AI assistant. Five specialized models for voice chat, PC control, file analysis and schedule management. No subscription. High‑risk actions always require your permission. Your data never leaves your PC.
